distanthorizons.config.client.threadPres:
Senker s n tiflik yepara Distant Horizons.

Zidda tḥeyyilt hadi tizwura imekren n yaskazyu n ɣir n amezghar d
tɛaddi n LOD, walakin tizwura iɣef izemzen CPU/RAM ẋuɣ tqemmimem.
Tazmamt: tḥeyyilt hadi tettependi ɣer CPU.
Taḍad tettesker ɣer 2 noodes n CPU d 64.

Nka
Tudert n LOD: ɣet tazibart

Tudert n tedmunit n Distant Horizons, tettmes taɣan f tisen.

Tazmamt: hadi tẓwura n tazart.
Tudert n ttiwnat meqqam tewwa ɣer tazart, tinwin ɣer iyen n wiyaƔ néglages.
Tqedrast n LOD

Ach tidert yepara bin taḍan n tqedrast n LOD?
Tinwin yuli tizwura tidert bin taḍan, walakin tizwura iɣef tazmamt d uɣulliwayeƔ.
Isew n tuddadt n tsiwel n uger

Taḍa muqala yenna yekhwen LOD.

§6Lutin:§r Lalak
§6Awwalen:§r Lalak
Taɣmi tsewvent

Ach yettawlan LOD yexxfen ṭḥad n tcasmaṯ, tiɣa, igbir, edlisen.

Nka yuli ima t-iḍam tikra nun uchukken m tazmamt.
Izemzen cwiya t tṣelmek l asekkar n nka

Ida yiṣad, DH yepara cwiya t tṣelmek id yedefru
wlad n nka n LOD.
Ida kad, DH yepara cwiya n lemin.

Ida yakan yekemmen idduren n kamera mehccan yedmen s ahwash.
Ida kf ittedmunit yekemmen idduren n qbel kamera yedmen s ahwash (misal Immersive Portals wala idduren n kamera).
Zidda nka id twezza

Ida yiṣad, nka n LOD tizwura id tazweddawt,
misal id tettzeml telescope wala emda n twezza.

Skan LOD d talwit n tṣelmek yettesker.

Id tazwedda, LOD tettɛaddan n tqedrast n tqeyrat
chimen ila yekhwen qrib.
Taɣa n zidda nka n twezza

Imirgen taḍan n tqedrast twezza tizwura nka n LOD.
Tinwin yuli yedfaƔen twezza aaplus ɣer wussani,
walakin tizwura tazmamt d uɣulliwayeƔ id twezza.

Telescope d tawra tilaḥ tiqit n tqedrast l nka tamana.
Asekti udmiḍ

Ach yettuɣan LOD ẓerum nka.

Tinwin qbeṣẓara l widl, wa t-iḍam tikra n tazmamt.
Taẓwart

Ach yettiwazzen LOD mn tnenba.

Tettkemmel i tawaɣeṣ t imzawk.

Enable LOD Block Models

If true nearby LODs will render blocks with their real shape 
instead of full cubes. 
If false all LODs render as full cubes. 

Only applies to the highest detail LODs.

Ida yiṣad, LOD yezzeyyen d cweḍ.
Ida kad, LOD yettuhun f temmurt yiane d tṣelmek.

Yellem ɣer yess-eqqen t ikra n bara.'
Iri n tawra

Ach tekkra al Minecraft tta ezf izemgen f LOD n Distant Horizons?

NONE: Kri ɣer yiɣdan n tazrara MC d DH.
SINGLE_PASS: Kri f yadmaten MC, itilen ki yakan ttim yettuznen.
DOUBLE_PASS: Shenṭer, kri f yadmaten LOD d MC.

Ila yebga DH yekra tikazmimen tili n taɣekkest n tayubi?
Hadi tayeb wajant bach tassa tẓrurt n ttal d DH.

Afsaẏet l tiẓẓan n tawra d teṭṭa l LOD chunen.

Tazmamt: tiᶓᶓwa muqala tizwura tẓermat d tɛaddi n LOD.

0: tiẓẓan n teṭṭa n tawra 1x1
1: tiẓẓan n teṭṭa n tawra 3x3
2: tiẓẓan n teṭṭa n tawra 5x5...

§6yiṣad:§r Minecraft yeſshows ihhuhu ndat.
§6kad:§r Ihhuhu n tawra ma yenburenɣin ttihdren f ilaken n tawra.

Tettgari ɣer idduren yettẓennan ihhuhu.
Tḥeyyllin yuli n ihhuhu
Ihhu ittef ed?

Ihhu ittef imked?

  0.0: Ihhu ittef di lemin.
  1.0: Ittef aneqqa ɣef uɣulli tkarjen i ihan n LOD.
  1.414: Uɣulli tkarjen i ihan n LOD n tawra yettases d ihhuhu.
Tini n ihhuhu

Ihhu kamen immed?

  0.0: Ihhu kama di lemin.
  1.0: Kama aneqqa ɣef uɣulli tkarjen i ihan n LOD.
  1.414: Uɣulli tkarjen i ihan n LOD n tawra yettases d ihhuhu.

Tekra n ihhuhu

Ach ttbeddelt iẓẓan n ihhuhu?

LINEAR: ɣer tudert (imkadan)
EXPONENTIAL: 1/(e^(tudert*izẓan))
EXPONENTIAL_SQUARED: 1/(e^((tudert*izẓan)^2))
Iẓẓan n ihhuhu
Ach yekra iẓẓan ylli yallan ihuhu?
Tḥeyyllin yuli n ihhuhu
Ihhuhu n ugor

Ach ihuhu n ugor tettfexa.

Ida ma tefhmteh ayan d egira: ara SFERICAL, ADDITION wala MAX.

SFERICAL: Ihuhu tettfexa ɣer tudert d tṣelmek.
CILINDRICAL: Ignoregh ugor, ihuhu tettfexa ɣer tudert iluh.
MAX: max(UgorIhuhu, TudertIhuhu)
ADDITION: UgorIhuhu + TudertIhuhu
MULTIPLY: UgorIhuhu * TudertIhuhu
INVERSE_MULTIPLY: 1 - (1-UgorIhuhu) * (1-TudertIhuhu)
LIMITED_ADDITION: TudertIhuhu + max(TudertIhuhu, UgorIhuhu)
MULTIPLY_ADDITION: TudertIhuhu + TudertIhuhu * UgorIhuhu
INVERSE_MULTIPLY_ADDITION: TudertIhuhu + 1 - (1-UgorIhuhu) * (1-TudertIhuhu)
AVERAGE: TudertIhuhu*0.5 + UgorIhuhu*0.5
Taḍa n ihhuhu n ugor

Ach yefses ihhuhu n ugor?

ABOVE_CAMERA: Ihhuhu n ugor yefses taɣef t tṣelmek.
BELOW_CAMERA: Ihhuhu n ugor yefses taḥta t tṣelmek.
ABOVE_AND_BELOW_CAMERA: Ihhuhu n ugor yefses taɣef d taḥta t tṣelmek.
ABOVE_SET_HEIGHT: Ihhuhu n ugor yefses taɣef t ugor yettut.
BELOW_SET_HEIGHT: Ihhuhu n ugor yefses taḥta t ugor yettut.
ABOVE_AND_BELOW_SET_HEIGHT: Ihhuhu n ugor yefses taɣef d taḥta t ugor yettut.

Taṣṣuret n LOD
ihder taṣṣuret n LOD

Ida yiṣad, LOD n qrib id twezza yettudmen ɣer taṣṣuret n ilaken
d sprite haṣṣa, machi iɣaran yedeggen.

Yettefseer s iqer bin taḍan ila taṣṣuret tayebin,
LOD n ɣir kollhom yepara iɣaran yedeggen.
Cay t tñala ɣer ida yiḍmn pack shader, ɣer paques n shader yettudmen LOD
ɣer convertisseur d ihlihom.
Taɣa n taḍa n tqedrast n taṣṣuret

Taḍa muqala yenna yettihdwen taṣṣuret n ilaken.
Taḍan muqalen, kulek LOD yeḥker tisen,
d taṣṣuret yettebixen ttiraq d ttara.
Tinwin yuli yedfaƔen taṣṣuret f LOD n ɣir, walakin tizwura tazmamt.
Ilaken bla taṣṣuret

Tebdant n ilaken ffes ɣer tqommimen fma DH ma yemmed taṣṣuret.
Tiṭṭimen d terẓiyen d tin d trachen kayen f tiyula n taṣṣuret.

Misal: "minecraft:grass_block,nylium"

Xmel Minecraft Ttqbir ach hada tettjemat.

ɣer taṣṣuret n ilak.

Tigin n ilaken bla iṭṭaf

ɣer taṣṣuret n ilak.

Xmel Minecraft Ttqbir ach hada tettjemat.

Tebdant n ilaken ffes ɣer tqommimen fma DH yepara pixel-art bach
yessiksegh iṭṭaf n taṣṣuret.

Tettiggin bach tufat masalan n idduren ila iṭṭaf
yepara s jerra n taṣṣuret 3D.

Misal: "minecraft:beacon"

Xmel Minecraft Ttqbir ach hada tettjemat.

Teṭṭa n tudert

Anta t tudert d tṣelmek ila Distant Horizons yebdi yessekker?

Tiɣẓi b ẓaf d tawra.
-1 = awir, teṭṭa tettfuɣet ɣef tudert d tawra.

Tinwin yuli isefr LOD ɣef ilaken n tawra n ɣir,
walakin tqarjen tqabuqin f LOD.

Tqabuqin kollha dduzan ɣerkin txiq ɣer wussani i ma yettbadelgh ad
lluqa iyinan len n tamazirt.

Tudert mliqa d tawra tizwura ɣeffa n hadi tḥeyyilt.
Teṭṭa n tudert d tikra n izza

Ida yakan, teṛṛa n teṭṭa tettahwud cikeɣ t tṣelmek
ima ttekkem yizzi izzinen.

Anane n ilaken
Ach n taḍad ila LOD yepara n ṭadit ɣef tiqit n tawra d cwiya?
ihder yaskazyu n tayubi yur

Xmel ibden Esekren tazmamt ach hada tettjemat.

Ida yiṣad, Distant Horizons yefka yur tayubi n ezmuniyya n tazmamt
bach yemfawi tini n tedmunit.

Ba speɣi yaskazyu n tayubi Distant Horizons
yetyalaken teṭṭiyen chimen t yettut n tḥeyyilt "distantGeneratorMode"
bach yesekkaziw tin d igziwen.

Ngenni tifaf hadi
ila kawri wussan msawran, bach ma tmektiw t
tayubi n ezmuniyya.
ihder ttedmunit
Ach ilaq ttedmunit n yaskazyu n amezghar ad tettwazrn.
Amdan n isekunden n ttedmunit
Ach yezga uzmaz ger iskayen n ttedmunit.
Sekwen ɔabé tẓuffa n ttedmunit

Imirgen n sekwen ila ttedmunit n yaskazyu n amezghar tettihdren ɔabé ma ttifyaf?
Ḥess 0 bach tẓuffa ttedmunit ma yebdi yaskazyu n amezghar.
ihder imekren n yaskazyw n ilaken f tqalen

Ida ttedmunit n yaskazyu tettihder, imekren
n yaskazyw n ilaken tettihder.

Teqfa akerkaw n nizla f l imekra.
Asser ɣer l iṭṭaḥḥu n tafukka

Ida tafukka n Minecraft talla
Distant Horizons yuddur yaskazyu n amezghar bach yurẓu iṭṭaḥḥu.
Idur l izza

Ida lemin/t tṣelmek yekhwen ẓaf yur,
Distant Horizons yuddur yaskazyu n amezghar bach yessokh
imekren d tɛaddi ẋuɣ yurẓu iṭṭaḥḥu.
Nqaden n yaskazyu n tayubi

Nqaden n tudert n LOD n taɣa ila teṣṣa
yetalu teṭṭiyen yesekkaziw
chimen t yettut n tḥeyyilt
"distantGeneratorMode".
distanthorizons.config.common.lodBuildin:
Kidem ila LOD ma yettbeddel ila titubdawen
n ilaken.

Anane n siyirigh yettzemlevan f init n LOD n yewin?

Yettefseer s iqer ba n init n yewin wala n titubdawin, wa ma yettefseer
ula init n iqebiyen yelli yettzemn
n titumina n init.

Lutin: LZ4
Sien: LZMA2

Ach ilaken yettumina f init n LOD?

Yettefseer s iqer ba n init n yewin wala n titubdawin n yewin
yettbeddelen.

Siyirigh ɣad: sefser ilaken id yedefren.
Lutin: siyirigh d f.

Xmel Minecraft Ttqbir ach hada tettjemat.

Taneẓẓiyen ɣebs yettiraawe yur ffek ẓe n init walakin
yettikker itfuqin id ukhun ẓe n hmayya
(yaḥta tifawet bla risque l kul taneẓẓa).

§6FULL§r
ACID - ma yettfuqu ma yettfekku
Lent

§6NORMAL§r
Yettfuqui ẓe n hmayya ɣer bla ttekku.
Yur

§6OFF§r
Yettfekku ẓe n hmayya
Lutin
Igezzer LOD ɣamman bach tufin tqabuqin

Ida yakan, DH yekker amken itḩa n ilaken LOD tufanin
s y en t iyulya yelli itta n lmis,
bach yecni tqabuqin igan turreft id
yaskazyu n temghad (ula server) yala n tafukka.

§6AMADAN§r Yezwura iꜣllem n disk imeqger imaza.
Tseregh init n tḥeyyilt.

distanthorizons.config.server.sendLevelK:
Tḥeyyllin n tafukka yelḥeqƔu ayafen t n lukut l kul amezghar.
Iḥeḥḥu hadi ila tettzeml iḥelluwen ɣer lebɣal t tokfa n lukut.
distanthorizons.config.server.levelKeyPr: Sezwen n ayafen t n lukut

Sezwen n ayafen t n lukut ila yettassanen lellimin.
Ida emda yessikes zaɣ t proxy, koll taḥṣabt igo yepara s enha.
Ida la número, ayafen t n lukut yettiqa aɣef lukut hash.
